page.layout: One printed label block in the centre of the page: a library bookplate with four centred lines of text and a small ornament between two lines. Handwriting in the upper left, the pencilled shelf mark at lower right, and a pencilled mark at upper left are not printed text and are left out.
page.notes: The bookplate lines are set in italic and small capitals; the first two lines are italic. The ornament between the second and third lines is a small decorative mark, transcribed here only as an approximation. Handwritten pencil notes (upper left "Q 3", upper centre a manuscript note about "Puritan" printing with a price, and lower right "SCB 11842") are shelf marks or manuscript annotations and are not transcribed as printed text.
